services.name: Pickleball Bootcamp
services.desc: Under the guidance of certified instructors, you’ll master drilling, live-ball hitting and strategic play so you can step straight into any open play sessions with total confidence. We’ve finished our pickleball bootcamps for the 2026 season, but don’t worry, more bootcamps are coming in 2027. Stay tuned for more details, and we look forward to seeing you on the courts! Three evenings on the court is all it takes to go from curious to confident. Bring your questions, meet a few new playing partners, and finish the weekend ready for open play. 9082 Clarkson Avenue Black Creek, BC, V9J 1B3 info@pacificplaygrounds.com 1 250

services.name: Fishing & Charters
services.desc: We’re partnered with Island Life Expeditions, based right here at the Resort - specialists in sportfishing and sightseeing ocean tours. Their expertise guarantees a memorable and successful fishing trip.​ If fishing isn’t your preference, Island Life Expeditions also offers scenic adventures where you might encounter seals, dolphins, orcas, humpback whales, and other wildlife, depending on the season.​ Experience the thrill of fishing or wildlife tours in the abundant waters of Vancouver Island with the comfort and convenience of Pacific Playgrounds and Island Life Expeditions. Book your charter today and create lasting memories on the water. 9082 Clarkson Avenue Black Creek, BC, V9J 1B3
